Surefire Cyber ’s approach and delivery are designed by industry veterans who have worked shoulder-to ­shoulder with law firms, insurance carriers, brokers, law enforcement, and impacted organizations in responding to cyber incidents. We are marshaling this experience to address the industry’s persistent challenges of efficiency, predictability, and transparency.

You are a seasoned cybersecurity professional with a strong background in digital forensics and incident response (DFIR), and incident management. You thrive in a dynamic and client-focused consulting environment, where you can tackle complex cybersecurity challenges. You are skilled at mitigating risks and making well-informed decisions, even in high-pressure scenarios.

title: LLM Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Join Hire Hangar and work with fast-growing global companies while building a long-term career.

Job Title: LLM Infrastructure Engineer
Location | Remote
Time Zone | US Time Zones (EST-PST)

Role Overview:
We are seeking an LLM Infrastructure Engineer with hands-on experience building the systems that power large language models. This is a full-time, hands-on engineering role focused on designing, deploying, and scaling the infrastructure behind model training, fine-tuning, and inference. You will work closely with machine learning and engineering teams to make sure models run reliably, efficiently, and cost-effectively in production. The ideal candidate understands both the demands of LLM workloads and the cloud systems needed to support them at scale.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design, build, and maintain infrastructure for training, fine-tuning, and serving large language models
- Deploy and scale LLM inference services with a focus on latency, throughput, and reliability
- Manage GPU compute resources and optimize workload scheduling and utilization
- Build and maintain data pipelines that support model training and evaluation
- Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting for model performance and system health
- Optimize infrastructure costs while maintaining performance and availability
- Automate deployment workflows using infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD practices
- Collaborate with ML engineers and researchers to move models from experimentation into production
- Proactively identify bottlenecks, investigate root causes, and resolve infrastructure issues

Required Qualifications:
- Proven experience building large language model infrastructure (non-negotiable)
- Hands-on experience deploying and serving machine learning models in production environments
- Strong programming skills in Python, with experience in systems or backend development
- Experience with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes
- Solid understanding of distributed systems, GPU computing, and performance optimization
- Strong written and spoken English with a clear, professional communication style
- Must have prior remote work experience, be fluent with remote collaboration tools and platforms (such as Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace, Asana, or similar), and have ideally worked with US or UK-based companies. Applications without this experience will not be considered.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Strong AWS experience, including services such as EC2, EKS, S3, and SageMaker
- Prior experience working at a large company or within enterprise-scale engineering environments
- Familiarity with LLM serving frameworks such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, or Triton Inference Server
- Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation
- Experience with distributed training frameworks such as PyTorch Distributed, DeepSpeed, or Ray

Tools & Technology:
- AWS
- Python
- Docker and Kubernetes
- Terraform or CloudFormation
- PyTorch and LLM serving frameworks
- CI/CD and monitoring tools
- Slack, Zoom, and other remote collaboration tools

description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Transactional Systems Engineer is responsible for the administration, configuration, optimization, and ongoing support of the organization's core healthcare transactional systems. This role serves as the primary technical and business liaison for Cedar Gate's EZ Suite, including EZCap, EZEDI, EZCare, and related applications, ensuring the platforms effectively support business operations, regulatory requirements, and organizational growth.

This individual partners closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, and vendors to implement software releases, hotfixes, system enhancements, and production support activities. The Transactional Systems Engineer is responsible for driving continuous improvement of business workflows, system configuration, automation, and operational efficiencies while ensuring platform stability, performance, and user satisfaction. This position reports to the VP of IT.

RESPONSIBILITIES - DUTIES

• Serve as the primary technical and functional owner of Cedar Gate's EZ Suite (EZCap, EZEDI, EZCare, and related applications), ensuring platform stability, performance, and operational excellence.

• Lead application lifecycle management, including application and environment readiness, database maintenance coordination, software upgrades, cumulative releases, hotfixes, patches, production deployments, testing, and validation.

• Partner with business stakeholders to analyze processes, gather requirements, recommend scalable solutions, and drive continuous improvement through automation and operational efficiencies.

• Monitor application health, troubleshoot production issues, maintain system documentation and standards, and ensure compliance with change management, HIPAA, security, and IT governance requirements.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

• 3+ years of hands-on experience administering Cedar Gate EZCap or a comparable healthcare administration platform required.

• Experience working within structured change management, release management, and IT governance processes.

• Work authorization for the United States required.

As a Regional Sales Manager at Verge.io , you’ll own and grow a defined territory, developing new customer relationships and expanding opportunities within our existing customer base. You’ll help organizations rethink how they approach virtualization and infrastructure by positioning VergeOS as a simpler, more efficient alternative for modern data center environments.

This is a full-cycle sales role. You’ll build your territory, develop pipeline, lead complex opportunities, and work closely with technical and channel resources to turn customer challenges into meaningful business opportunities.

The Role:

You’ll take ownership of your territory and the opportunities within it, from initial prospecting through close and expansion. That includes:

• Developing and executing a territory plan focused on building pipeline and achieving revenue targets

• Identifying and engaging high-value target accounts

• Prospecting into new accounts through outbound outreach, networking, events, partner relationships, and inbound opportunities

• Leading the full sales cycle from discovery and qualification through negotiation and close

• Building relationships with executives and key stakeholders across IT infrastructure, virtualization, and operations

• Understanding each customer’s business priorities and infrastructure challenges to position VergeOS effectively

• Managing complex, multi-stakeholder opportunities using a structured sales approach

• Developing expansion opportunities within existing customer relationships

• Maintaining a healthy, multi-stage pipeline and providing accurate forecasts

• Keeping opportunity and account information current and accurate in Salesforce.

Who You Are

Successful Sales Managers at Verge.io are comfortable creating opportunities, not just managing ones.

You know how to build a territory, open doors, ask the right questions, and develop relationships across an organization. You can understand a customer’s technical challenges without needing to be the deepest technical expert in the room, and you know how to translate those challenges into business value.

You’re also comfortable working as part of a team. You’ll partner closely with a Solutions Architect on technical discovery, demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, and solution strategy, while working with our Channel team to develop partner relationships and partner-sourced opportunities.

Most importantly, you take ownership of your business, from pipeline development and account strategy to forecasting and ultimately closing revenue.

The Experience We’re Looking For

We typically look for:

• 7+ years of B2B technology sales experience, ideally within enterprise or infrastructure software

• A demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding quota in a complex, solution-oriented sales environment

• Experience developing net-new business and building pipeline within a defined territory

• Experience managing longer, multi-stakeholder sales cycles

• The ability to build credibility and communicate business value with executives, technical leaders, and other stakeholders

• Experience selling infrastructure software, virtualization, HCI, or adjacent technologies

• Strong territory planning, account management, forecasting, and opportunity management skills

• Experience working with CRM platforms such as Salesforce

• Comfort operating with autonomy in a fast-moving, high-growth technology company

Additional Experience That’s Valuable

Experience in any of the following areas can be especially helpful:

• Selling virtualization, HCI, storage, networking, or data center technologies

• Competing against platforms such as VMware or Nutanix

• Working with channel partners as part of a broader go-to-market strategy

• Selling into MSP, CSP, enterprise, or other complex IT environments

• Mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung als Data Analyst, Business Analyst, Analytics Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren analytischen Rolle

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in SQL, Python und Git sowie Erfahrung in der Erstellung von Dashboards und Reports mit Power BI

• Analytisches Denkvermögen, ein gutes Verständnis für Business-Zusammenhänge sowie eine strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise zeichnen dich aus

• Sehr gute Deutsch - und Englischkenntnisse ( mind. C1-Niveau ) sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern

• Lernen & Entwicklung: Nutze Sprachkurse, Schulungen und Experten-Sessions, um deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen.

• Mentoring-Programm: Vernetze dich mit erfahrenen Kollegen, um Einblicke zu gewinnen und deine Karriere zu beschleunigen.

Bei Flix konzentrieren wir uns darauf, Reisen einfach, sicher und erschwinglich zu gestalten - sowohl für unsere Passagiere als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter. Hier geht es schnell voran, und es gibt viel Raum, etwas zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns täglich weiter und suche

Robot Software builds the on-vehicle software platform that Wayve’s AI Driver runs on. This is a remote position.
Remote (US-based) · Independent contractor · ~15-20 hrs/week ongoing · Reports to the Senior Medical Director
About Shapely

Shapely is transforming the weight loss industry through an innovative physician-led approach that makes weight loss care affordable for everyone. With evidence-based care, industry-leading support, and a seamless integrated app, we help thousands of patients across California, Florida, New York, and Texas access GLP-1 therapies and comprehensive weight management, all covered by insurance, including Medicare. Most of our patients are over 65.
Our care model is longitudinal and includes MDs/DOs, NPs, PAs, and RDNs. We bill fee-for-service and also participate in MIPS.
The role
You'll be the person who makes sure what we document supports what we bill, and that we're capturing everything we legitimately earn. This is a hands-on coding and auditing role reporting to the Senior Medical Director - not a policy, billing-clerk, or general compliance position.
You'll work in two modes. Prospectively, you'll help us assess which codes are safe to use for a given visit type as well as what documentation needs to be present to use teh coe compliantly. Retrospectively, you'll audit charts to confirm the documentation holds up with high accuracy, and turn opportunities for improvement into templates, workflow fixes, and education.
What you'll do
Audit

• Conduct a baseline documentation audit (10-20 charts per billing provider) across encounters, and deliver a findings report with error rates by provider and service line

• Run ongoing quarterly audits (10 charts per provider) plus focused service-line reviews.

• Perform 100% pre-bill review during new-code rollouts until the error rate is under 5%

• Place any provider above a 10% error rate on monthly review with targeted education until they're back under threshold

Code evaluation

• Evaluate appropriateness of unused or underused codes for our care model and define the documentation each requires before we bill it

• Write documentation guidance for our clinical staff and billing team.

MIPS

• Assist with success with MIPS, including determining appropriate measures and ensuring our documentation exceeds requirements.

• Provide suggestions on enhancing our templates to optimize accuracy and compliance with MIPS

Requirements
Required

• CPC (AAPC) or CCS-P (AHIMA)

• CPMA strongly preferred, or equivalent demonstrated chart-audit experience

• 5+ years coding outpatient E/M, with direct auditing experience

• Strong knowledge of Medicare telehealth rules

• Experience with MIPS reporting and quality-measure documentation

• US-based, with strong Medicare experience

Nice to have

• Obesity medicine, endocrinology, or primary care background

• Prior work with OIG self-disclosure or payer audit response

• Experience building documentation templates or clinician cheat-sheets

title: Co-Op, Materials Science, Heterogeneous Catalysis
description:
Your Impact at LILA

As a Co-Op in Materials Science, Heterogeneous Catalysis, you will join Lila's Materials Science team at our Alewife site to help build and run high-throughput workflows for catalyst synthesis, characterization, and performance testing.

You will work hands-on in the lab: preparing catalyst samples, running reactor tests, and analyzing the resulting data for trends in structure, composition, and catalytic performance. You will work alongside scientists, automation engineers, and data scientists, and you will see how experimental work connects to AI-guided materials discovery.

This is a practical, lab-based co-op suited to a graduate student who wants real ownership of experiments and exposure to automated, data-rich science.

What You'll Be Building

• Synthesize heterogeneous catalysts and prepare samples for performance testing

• Run batch and flow reactor tests, measuring activity, selectivity, and stability

• Characterize materials using techniques such as XRD, BET, TGA, or chemisorption

• Analyze experimental data to identify structure and composition trends

• Support automated and high-throughput synthesis workflows with the engineering team

• Document protocols and results, and present findings to the team

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Currently enrolled in a Masters or PhD program in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related field

• Hands-on laboratory experience with materials synthesis or catalyst testing

• Working knowledge of common characterization techniques (XRD, BET, TGA, FTIR, or similar)

• Ability to handle chemicals safely and follow lab safety protocols

• Strong attention to detail in experimental execution and record keeping

• Clear written and verbal communication of experimental results

Bonus Points For

• Experience with batch or flow reactors, or gas sorption measurements

• Exposure to high-throughput experimentation or lab automation platforms

• Data analysis or scripting in Python, R, or MATLAB

• Coursework or research involving zeolites, MOFs, or other porous materials

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy .

Lila Sciences does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science’s internal Talent Acquisition team. title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
About Us

Trase is the operating system for high-stakes environments, providing end-to-end solutions for deploying, managing, and optimizing AI within industries where security, governance, and data sovereignty are non-negotiable.

Our HIPAA- and SOC 2-compliant platform bridges the “last mile” of AI adoption, empowering sectors like healthcare and national security to run trustworthy, predictable AI agents across any model or environment-whether in the cloud, on-prem, or at the edge-with unified policy enforcement, continuous monitoring, and fully immutable audit trails.

Trase’s suite of products includes Origin, its agentic operating system; Leagues, its marketplace for specialized, configurable, ready-to-deploy agents; and Arena, where developers build, evaluate, and package the agents that run on Origin. The company has repeatedly topped Hugging Face’s GAIA Leaderboard for Generalized AI Assistants, placing it firmly at the forefront of AI-agent innovation.

About the Role
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Trase, you’ll build and deploy AI agents and applications that solve real customer problems using Trase OS. You’ll join Leagues, our industry verticals team, supporting customers in healthcare, state and local government and education (SLED), financial services, or retail. Your focus may be one or more of these verticals; experience in all four is not required.
This is a hands-on software engineering role with direct customer ownership. You’ll work with users to understand their workflows, turn unclear requirements into technical plans, and take solutions from prototype through production. You’ll partner closely with Product, ML, and the Origin and Arena engineering teams to build on Trase OS and feed customer needs back into the platform.
We are hiring at Mid, Senior and Staff levels. Level will reflect your demonstrated engineering depth, independence, and scope of ownership.
Why This Role is Needed
Customer value depends on how well AI works within existing systems, data, and day-to-day operations. Leagues connects Trase OS to those environments and turns platform capabilities into solutions customers can use and trust.
This role exists to:

• Deliver working solutions that improve customer workflows and produce measurable outcomes.

• Bridge customer needs and platform engineering, identifying gaps early and shaping practical solutions.

• Turn successful deployments into reusable integrations and patterns that help future customers launch faster.

What makes this role challenging

• Customer environments vary in data quality, integration options, security requirements, and operational readiness.

• AI behavior must be evaluated against real workflows, including failure cases, escalation paths, and human review.

• You must balance delivery speed with reliability and maintainability, while deciding what belongs in a customer solution versus the shared platform.

Responsibilities

• Work directly with customers to map workflows, identify useful AI applications, and agree on scope, success measures, and acceptance criteria.

• Build production-quality agents, applications, APIs, and integrations using Trase OS, including backend services and user interfaces as needed.

• Integrate customer systems, data sources, and identity providers; work with infrastructure engineers to deploy in customer or Trase-managed environments.

• Own delivery through testing, deployment, customer validation, and operational handoff. Surface dependencies, risks, and scope changes early.

• Build evaluations, automated tests, observability, and human review or escalation into agent workflows; validate quality, latency, cost, and reliability.

• Apply appropriate access controls, data-handling policies, and audit logging in partnership with Security and customer teams.

• Debug production issues across application, data, integration, and infrastructure layers; document solutions and create practical runbooks.

• Contribute reusable components

title: vIOP Psychiatrist
description:
At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health. Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!

We are looking for a vIOP Psychiatrist to join our Clinical & Quality Operations team. The vIOP Psychiatrist plays a key psychiatric and medical role within the organization's Virtual Intensive Outpatient Program (vIOP). This position is responsible for conducting psychiatric admissions assessments, providing ongoing psychiatric evaluation and clinical guidance, and supporting the treatment team in delivering safe, effective, and clinically appropriate care. The Psychiatrist will maintain a strong understanding of the vIOP clinical model, including its three program tracks, age groups, programming, clinical workflows, and patient populations. The Psychiatrist will actively participate in treatment team meetings and provide psychiatric consultation and recommendations regarding patient care. The role will also be responsible for reviewing and signing off on patient discharges, ensuring that patients are clinically appropriate for discharge and that appropriate follow-up and transition plans are in place. As a collaborative member of the vIOP team, the Psychiatrist will serve as a key psychiatric resource for the clinical team and support the delivery of high-quality, patient-centered behavioral healthcare. To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare.

This is a remote position based on Eastern time. Talkspace Headquarters is located in NYC.

What You’ll Do

• Psychiatric Assessment & Admission

• Conduct comprehensive psychiatric admissions assessments for patients entering the vIOP.

• Evaluate psychiatric symptoms, diagnoses, risk factors, functional needs, and appropriateness for the vIOP level of care.

• Determine psychiatric treatment needs and provide clinical recommendations as part of the admission process.

• Identify patients who may require a higher or different level of care and escalate concerns appropriately.

• Complete required psychiatric documentation in accordance with organizational and clinical standards.

• Treatment Team & Clinical Collaboration

• Actively participate in recurrent treatment team meetings and collaborate with clinicians, facilitators, and Clinical leadership regarding patient care.

• Provide psychiatric consultation and clinical guidance to the treatment team regarding patient presentation, treatment planning, risk, and level of care.

• Collaborate with the treatment team to identify changes in patient presentation or treatment needs and determine appropriate clinical interventions.

• Serve as a psychiatric resource for facilitators and clinicians managing complex clinical presentations or safety concerns.

• Communicate significant clinical concerns and recommendations to appropriate members of the care team and Clinical leadership.

• Patient Care, Treatment, and  Discharge

• Provide ongoing psychiatric evaluation and clinical support for patients receiving care through the vIOP, as appropriate to the program model.

• Provide clinical recommendations related to diagnosis, treatment planning, risk, level of care, and coordination of care.

• Assess and respond to changes in patient presentation, including suicidal ideation, acute psychiatric symptoms, and other safety concerns.

• Collaborate with clinicians and facilitators to support safe and clinically appropriate patient care and determine when escalation to a higher level of care is indicated.

• Participate in treatment planning and provide psychiatric input regarding patients with complex clinical presentations or evolving treatment needs.

• Review and sign off on the discharge of each vIOP

title: Senior Software Engineer - Storage
description:
WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a Senior Software Engineer - Storage, you will design, build, and operate the storage services and data capabilities that run demanding cloud and AI workloads at scale on Radiant's platform.

You'll work across object, block, and file storage, data lifecycle, performance, resilience, APIs, and platform integrations. You'll partner closely with product, infrastructure, SRE, networking, and security teams, and with customers running the most demanding storage workloads.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You'll own significant parts of the storage platform from design through production, working alongside our Principal Engineers on its architecture.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Design, build, and own components of Radiant's storage services, and contribute to the architecture and technical designs for the platform.

- Build storage systems across object, block, and file, including control plane and data plane services and their integration with existing Radiant services.

- Turn product and customer requirements into well-designed APIs and implementations, working with the Storage Product Manager and Principal Engineers.

- Deliver against the performance, durability, availability, and consistency targets of the storage platform.

- Profile, benchmark, and tune throughput, latency, and IOPS for AI training, inference, and other data-intensive workloads.

- Build integrations between storage and compute, Kubernetes (CSI), networking, IAM, observability, and developer tooling.

- Build for failure through replication, snapshots, data protection, failure recovery, and safe upgrades at scale.

- Take part in on-call and operational work with SRE, including capacity planning, observability, incident response, and post-incident improvements.

- Contribute to engineering standards through design and code review, and support less experienced engineers.

 

YOUR PROFILE

- Solid experience building and operating distributed storage systems or storage-heavy cloud infrastructure.

- Experience owning significant components end to end, from design through production and operation.

- Strong hands-on engineering skills in one or more systems languages such as Go or similar.

- Strong technical knowledge across several of:

- Storage: object, block, and file storage, snapshots, replication, erasure coding, caching, tiering, data lifecycle

- Protocols & interfaces: S3, NFS, SMB, CSI, NVMe/NVMe-oF, RDMA, POSIX semantics, storage APIs

- Infrastructure: Kubernetes, containers, high-performance networking, GPU clusters, cloud platforms

- Reliability: durability, availability, consistency models, consensus, failure recovery, data integrity

- Observability & security: metrics, logging, tracing, IAM, encryption at rest and in transit, auditability

- Experience with technologies such as WEKA, VAST, DDN, Lustre, Ceph, MinIO, Pure Storage, or similar.

- Familiarity with AI and HPC storage patterns, such as large-scale training data pipelines, checkpointing, and high-throughput parallel file systems.

- Able to reason about trade-offs between performance, durability, availability, cost, and operational complexity.

- Clear written and verbal communication, including design documents and explaining trade-offs to your team and stakeholders.

- Comfortable working with customers on technical problems.

 

WHAT YOU BRING

- Storage domain expertise: Understand how storage architecture affects application and workload performance, down to the hardware.

- Engineering excellence: Write well-tested, maintainable code and give thoughtful code reviews.

- Sound judgement: Make careful design decisions on systems where data loss is not an option.

- Collaboration: Work closely with Principal Engineers, product, SRE, and other teams, and help the engineers around you grow.

- Systems thinking: Understand how storage interacts with compute, networking, and the rest of the cloud platform.

- Ownership: Drive storage capabilities from design

Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Sharing this story with the world is just as important as the science and engineering behind it.

We're looking for a creative, proactive, and digitally savvy Social Media Manager to build and grow our social media presence, starting with LinkedIn. As our first dedicated social media hire, you'll have the opportunity to establish our social media strategy, develop a consistent content engine, and bring Focused Energy's innovations, people, and progress to life for audiences around the world.

You'll work closely with our Communications team and subject-matter experts across science, engineering, and business to turn complex technical developments into engaging, accessible content. From employer branding and thought leadership to company milestones and community engagement, you'll help shape how the world sees and connects with Focused Energy.

This is an exciting opportunity to build something from the ground up, take ownership of growing digital channels, and help amplify the story of a company working at the forefront of clean energy innovation.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own Our Social Media Presence: Lead the day-to-day strategy, planning, and execution of Focused Energy's LinkedIn presence, including content development, publishing cadence, and channel growth.

- Drive Employer Branding and Thought Leadership: Develop content that highlights our people, culture, technical expertise, company milestones, partnerships, and innovations to strengthen our reputation and support talent attraction.

- Grow and Engage Our Community: Manage day-to-day community interactions, responding to followers, candidates, partners, and other audiences in a timely, authentic, and on-brand manner.

- Explore New Opportunities: Evaluate emerging platforms and additional social channels, making recommendations on where and how Focused Energy should expand its digital presence.

- Measure and Optimize Performance: Track key social media metrics, analyze audience engagement and content performance, and use insights to continuously improve our strategy, formats, and publishing approach.

- Support Campaigns and Key Initiatives: Coordinate social media activity around company announcements, events, product and technology milestones, partnerships, and recruiting campaigns.

- Maintain Brand and Content Standards: Ensure all published content reflects Focused Energy's voice, brand identity, and communication standards, working with the appropriate stakeholders to validate scientific accuracy and manage sensitive topics.

- Support Paid and Organic Social Activity: Execute organic social initiatives and contribute to paid social campaigns within approved strategies and budgets.

title: Клієнт-менеджер/ка (Служба турботи про користувачів)
description:
💫Про RIA.com

Ми - українська продуктова ІТ-компанія RIA.com , яка розвиває відомі маркетплейси AUTO.RIA, DIM.RIA, AGRO.RIA та RIA.com . Нашими продуктами користуються мільйони українців, тож команда фахівців наполегливо працює над покращеннями та пошуками інноваційних рішень.

Ми шукаємо Клієнт-менеджера в команду Служби турботи про користувачів. На цій позиції ти будеш допомагати клієнтам швидко та якісно вирішувати їхні запити.

🔷 Які задачі стоять перед Клієнт-менеджером:

•
Телефонні консультації : відповідає на вхідні та здійснює вихідні дзвінки клієнтів та допомагає у вирішенні їх запитів щодо продуктів компанії: AUTO.RIA, DIM.RIA, AGRO.RIA та RIA.com .

•
Письмові консультації : опрацювання звернень від користувачів в чатах та електронній пошті.

•
Сервісні запити: робота з CRM системою Creatio та взаємодія з іншими командами.

В середньому клієнт-менеджер отримує 60-80 звернень за робочий день.

⚡️ Тепер про очікування до кандидата, якого шукаємо:

• Досвід роботи з клієнтами: телефонні консультації або офлайн-взаємодія.

• Турботливий підхід та емпатія: вміння розуміти потреби клієнта й прагнення допомогти.

• Орієнтація на високий рівень сервісу: здатність забезпечити якісний клієнтський досвід навіть у складних ситуаціях.

Буде перевагою:

• Досвід роботи з CRM-системами.

• Досвід роботи у сфері підтримки клієнтів або контакт-центрі.

🔗 Про етапи інтерв'ю:

• Після відбору твого резюме - телефонний дзвінок з рекрутером.

• Співбесіда в онлайн форматі з Лідеркою команди та тренером.

• Запрошення на оплачуване стажування віддалено або в офісі (2-3 тижні)

📌Що на тебе чекає в RIA.com ?

•
Практичне втілення командних цінностей : відкрита комунікація, індивідуальні тренінги з тренером, фідбек, підтримка наставника із першого дня для швидкої адаптації, без мікроменеджменту чи тайм-трекерів.

•
Комфортні умови роботи : віддалений або гібридний формат роботи, плаваючі 8-годинні зміни (4/2; 3/2; 3/1; 2/1) зі стартом між 08:00 та 14:00 та обідньою перервою, офіційне працевлаштування.

•
Здоров’я та турбота про себе: онлайн-консультації корпоративного лікаря та підтримка ментального здоров’я з психологом, оплачувані лікарняні та 20 робочих днів оплачуваної відпустки.

•
Можливості розвитку: перехід між категоріями для кар'єрного зростання, отримання бонусів за чітко визначеною системою KPI. Індивідуальні тренінги та участь у внутрішніх конкурсах для розвитку професійних навичок. Компенсація вивчення іноземних мов та бонусна програма для підтримки хобі та відпочинку ріакомівців.

RIA.com - соціально відповідальна українська компанія. «Авто для ЗСУ» від AUTO.RIA - це фандрейзинговий проєкт, який офіційно працює з 2023 року. Завдяки активному залученню команди, креативним ініціативам і колабораціям із зірками та українським бізнесом, ми придбали та відправили більше 40 автівок: пікапи, позашляховики, тягачі та вантажівки для військових у найгарячіші напрямки.

Більше про те, як ми працюємо, можна дізнатися тут:
що саме команда формує продукти, які стають лідерами ринку, тож чекаємо твоє резюме! Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Director, Project Management - Manufacturing
description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. 

 

About the Company

Fanatics Collectibles is a new company operating at the intersection of collectibles, culture, and technology. Backed by world-class investors, operators, and sports & entertainment partners, we are building the global leader in next-generation collectibles. As part of the broader Fanatics ecosystem, we leverage a digital sports platform that spans over 900 sports properties and engages more than 81 million fans. Together, we are reimagining every part of the collectibles experience for fans, partners, and creators.

 

Role Summary

Fanatics Collectibles makes trading cards and collectibles for the world's leading sports and entertainment properties. As the business scales its in-house production, it needs a dedicated leader to deliver and support its manufacturing footprint.

The Director, Project Management - Manufacturing will lead project management for Fanatics Collectibles' manufacturing facilities. This starts with the Sunnyvale, CA and Allen, TX plants and extends to future facilities across the United States and, over time, worldwide. The role covers the full project lifecycle: early budget estimates and planning, design and value engineering, construction, equipment installation and commissioning, production ramp-up, and close-out. It also supports ongoing plant operations through capital improvements, reconfigurations and expansions.

This is an owner-side leadership role. The Director will set direction for and manage a team of external partners, including project managers, architects and engineers, process and equipment engineers, and general contractors. The Director is accountable for delivering every project safely, on schedule, within budget, and to the operating needs of the manufacturing business.

Key Responsibilities

Program and project leadership

• Lead every manufacturing facility project from concept through close-out: new builds, fit-outs, expansions, reconfigurations and capital improvements at existing plants.

• Set up and run a consistent project delivery framework for Fanatics Collectibles manufacturing, covering stage gates, approvals, reporting, and document control.

• Manage several projects at once at different sites, and balance resources and priorities across the portfolio.

Budgets, cost and value engineering

• Prepare and validate early budget estimates and capital requests for leadership approval.

• Own project budgets, contingency, forecasting and change-order control, and report variances and risks early.

• Lead value engineering efforts that reduce cost and schedule without hurting production performance, quality or safety.

Manufacturing process and equipment integration

• Work with manufacturing and engineering teams to turn production requirement

title: IT Service Operations Analyst — Federal Health IT
description:
IT Service Operations Analyst - Federal Health IT
Location: Remote - United States
Security Requirement: Eligibility for a Tier 3 federal investigation; active U.S. Government Secret clearance required for designated assignments.
Keep Support Moving. Strengthen Service Reliability.
At Rackner , reliable technology support helps federal healthcare organizations maintain the systems and services their teams depend on. We're seeking an IT Service Operations Analyst to support efficient service request handling, strengthen operational accountability, and help ensure technology issues are accurately documented, prioritized, and directed to the appropriate specialists.
In this role, you'll work across ServiceNow ITSM operations, service-level performance tracking, operational reporting, and application support activities. You'll collaborate with specialized teams, monitor service commitments, identify recurring issues, and help improve the consistency, visibility, and reliability of healthcare technology support.
What You'll Do

• Triage, categorize, and route incoming incidents and service requests across designated ServiceNow ITSM queues, applying established operational procedures to ensure accurate case assignment.

• Coordinate handoffs to clinical workflow, training, account provisioning, application, and technical specialists, maintaining visibility into ticket progress, outstanding dependencies, and appropriate follow-up.

• Monitor established response and resolution windows, track service-level agreement (SLA) clocks, and document approved pause reasons and service delays in accordance with defined procedures.

• Maintain accurate ticket histories, status updates, supporting documentation, and audit-ready closure evidence to strengthen accountability and operational traceability.

• Analyze ticket activity, recurring issues, and service trends to prepare weekly operational reviews and provide accurate inputs to monthly performance reporting.

• Administer and validate assigned non-production and sandbox environments following upgrades, perform authorized operational checks, and document findings requiring additional technical attention.

• Track inherited application defects through documented disposition, maintaining assigned owners, severity classifications, progress updates, and supporting evidence.

Required Qualifications

• ITIL 4 Foundation certification.

• Minimum of two years of professional experience in ServiceNow IT Service Management (ITSM) queue operations, including demonstrated capability in ticket triage, routing, service-level monitoring, and maintaining accurate operational records.

• Eligibility to undergo the applicable Tier 3 federal investigation. Certain assignments require an active U.S. Government Secret security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

• Supporting service desk operations or IT service management within federal healthcare or similarly complex, regulated technology environments.

• Experience using ServiceNow reporting capabilities to analyze service trends, monitor ticket activity, or support operational performance reporting.
